# Vendored detection engine

`sentinel-scan.js` in this directory is a byte-for-byte copy of
[`Ventrova/sentinel-scan-cli`](https://github.com/Ventrova/sentinel-scan-cli)'s
`bin/sentinel-scan.js`, pinned at a known commit so the extension doesn't take
a runtime dependency on an unpublished npm package (sentinel-scan-cli isn't on
the npm registry yet - publish is blocked on an org token, see that repo).

This extension only calls two pure, side-effect-free exports:

- `scanMcpManifest(manifestObject)` - runs all MCP heuristics, returns
  `{ summary, results }`.
- `mcpSarifLineForTool(rawSourceText, toolName)` - best-effort 1-indexed line
  number for a finding, used to place the VS Code diagnostic.

Do not edit this file directly. To pick up new/improved heuristics, re-copy
`bin/sentinel-scan.js` from the CLI repo and bump `vendoredFrom` below.

- vendoredFrom: Ventrova/sentinel-scan-cli@2076175 (2026-08-24)

Once sentinel-scan-cli is published to npm, replace this vendored copy with a
real `dependencies` entry and drop this directory.
